lookbackDuration.description:
A lookback duration for the current reconstruction algorithm that helps determine the time interval in which data
should be fetched.

reconstructionSuffix.description: An optional suffix that is added to the column names of the reconstruction {@link Data}.

residualSuffix.description: An optional suffix that is added to the column names of the residual {@link Data}.

id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

userUpdatedFields.description:
System managed field that keeps track of which fields in the seed data obj were updated by a user (as opposed to
the provisioner/authorizer).  Fields in seed data objs that are updated by users will not have those changes
overridden by provisioning.

hidden.description:
Field that marks a seed data obj as hidden.  When a seed data obj that was created via provisioning (e.g owned by
c3), user removals of that obj are handled by marking the obj as hidden to prevent future provisioning from causing
them to reappear.

userOwned.description:
A seed data entry is considered to be user owned if either this flag is true or the {@link Meta#created created}
field of {@link Persistable#meta} is not the authorizer or provisioner.  This field is completely managed by the
system.  It will be set while creating an entry if it is being created by the authorizer and the
{@link UpsertSpec#forceUserUpdate} is set to true.

typeIdent.description:
Indicates explicit sub-type of entry.  Composed of the concatenation of the typeKey of the instance's type and all
of its base type's typeIdent

frozen.description: If true, then the pipe shall not be retrained

trained.description: True if training has succeeded and false otherwise.

flattenInput.description: If true, the underlying model only accepts flattened input.

hyperparamOverrides.description: The hyperparameters overridden of a native model or pipe.

hyperparamSearchSpace.description:
A collection of {@link Hp.ParamSpace}s for the hyperparameters of this pipe. This search space will be used to
perform hyperparameter searches.

hpoSpec.description:
Used to provide configuration for {@link #search}. Some configurations include how to validate results, which
search algorithms will be used, and limits on execution iterations.

hpoExperiment.description: {@link Hpo.Experiment} stores the result of hyperparameter optimization to find the best model/pipeline.

experiment.description: Reference to the experiment that produced this {@link MlPipe}. For example, this could be a {@link Hpo.ExperimentBase}.

modelFiles.description:
Map of urls of saved model files
key - model file name, value - {@link Url} corresponding to model file name

customModelCode.description:
A map containing {Module Name: Compressed Source Code} key-value pairs. The module name is the name of the
module from where the source code was taken from. (i.e. numpy).

processFunc.description: Name for the function on the native model to call to do {@link MlProcessable#process}.

underlyingPipe.description:
A pipe that contains the native model and implements {@link MlAtomicPipe#doProcess} and optionally
{@link MlAtomicPipe#doTrain}. If set, the implementation of the APIs on the `MlAtomicPipe` interface will be
dispatched through the underlying pipe. Otherwise, the developer has an additional responsibility to implement the
APIs.
DEVELOPER NOTE: If sub-types of {@link MlTemplate.AtomicPipe} is designed to have `underlyingPipe`, it is required to
override {@link MlTemplate.AtomicPipe#hasUnderlyingPipe} and return `True`

randomSeed.description: Random seed used during model training. Use the same number for reproducible training results.

learningRateOverride.description:
Learning rate used to override the learning rate specified in the `optimizer` during training.
Will use optimizer's learning rate if `learningRateOverride` is unspecified.

windowSize.description:
A window length specifying how many time stamps to reconstruct at a time. The {@link Data} input will be batched
into consecutive, single-stride windows of size {@link #windowSize}, and the number of windows to be fed into the
model at a time is defined by {@link #batchSize}.

directionalWeights.description:
Dictionary that maps feature names to (negativeValueCoef, positiveValueCoef) in order to incorporate SME knowledge
of a feature's anomalous directions. The negativeValueCoef is the multiplicative coefficient for
negative residuals within that feature, so a negativeValueCoef of 0 would zero out negative residuals when calculating
loss whereas a negativeValueCoef of 1 would leave the residual untouched. In other words, a negativeValueCoef of 0 implies
that this feature is only anomalous in the positive direction, and a negative residual should not create a spike in risk score.
This translates equivalently to the positiveValueCoef, which is multiplied against positive residuals. These coefficients should
be between 0 and 1. Notice that here "residuals" means `sensor values - reconstructions`.

If left unspecified, will not multiply residuals by any coefficient and will not have any feature directionality.

CAUTION! These weights are applied during model training, which will cause the reconstructions of a sensor to be biased towards
one direction if negativeValueCoef and positiveValueCoef are not the same. This is usually not the result we want. Please refer to
{@link ReliabilityRiskMl.RiskScoreComputation.DirectionallyWeightedComputationPipe} for the directional weights that are applied only at
inference time for the computation of risk scores.

numEncoderConvolutionalLayers.description: Number of Conv layers in the encoder. Will also be used for number of Conv layers in the decoder.

latentDimension.description: Dimension of the vector in the middle of the encoder, the output of "bottleneck" Dense layer

filterScaleFactor.description:
Multiplies filter size at each layer by this number in 3d case and divides filter
size at each layer by this number in 2d case. For example in 2d case for `starting_filter=16`, `filter_scale=2`,
`num_conv_layers=3` filter sizes for each conv layer = `[16, 8, 4]`.

kernelSize.description: Size of the 1D convolution kernel sizes along the time axis.

numEncoderDenseLayers.description: Number of Dense layers in the encoder. Will also be used for number of Conv layers in the decoder.

activation.description: Activation function to use on all convolutional layers. (Middle Dense layers are both linear activation).

useDropout.description: Whether and where to use a dropout layer. Ignored if unspecified.

dropoutProbability.description: Dropout layer's drop probability that must be between `0` and `1`, exclusive.

useBatchNormalization.description: Whether and where to use a batch normalization layer. Ignored if unspecified.

useKernelRegularizers.description: Whether and where to use a kernel regularizer. Does not use if `null`.

kernelRegularizationType.description: Kernel regularizer type as specified in `tensorflow.keras.regularizers`. Ignored if {@link #useKernelRegularizers} is unspecified.

kernelRegularizationConstant.description: Kernel regularization constant to use. Ignored if {@link #useKernelRegularizers} is unspecified.

reconstructionLoss.description: Reconstruction loss to be used by the autoencoder.

title:
This type represents an {@link MlPipe} template for a Keras-based 1D Convolutional Autoencoder. This pipe will
build and train a convolutional autoencoder on 2D timeseries data based on the user-specified hyperparameters. The
outputs will be the reconstructed input, the residual between the reconstruction and the original input, and the
projection of the original input in the autoencoder latent space.
name: Reconstruction.Algorithm.Conv1dAutoencoderPipe
